historical_reference_context.scope: Prior fresh mx rates from the native-widen16-call round, retained solely as historical context. Not measured alongside this tile64 repeat; do not combine rounds into a paired ratio.

reference.required_recheck: actual F32-KV Vulkan adapter source/hash, linked libraries and --list-devices; do not substitute CPU or default-f16-KV wrapper

settings.phase_scope: Each phase resets history; decode is not continuation after prefill. One warmup of each phase precedes r1.
settings.context: mx context512; llmx model logical context262144 with lazy backing. Actual pp/tg token streams match; allocated KV layouts differ.

mx.required_recheck: actual F32-KV Vulkan adapter source/hash, linked libraries and --list-devices; do not substitute CPU or default-f16-KV wrapper

summary.control_interpretation: Behavior-preserving same-owner dispatch-code control, not pure address layout. For reachable heights32/64/128, the F16 min(height,64) expression equals the explicit tall-to-short condition; other types are unchanged. Actual matmul_group_impl code shrinks from22116 to22069 bytes, row-run helper code/placement changes, and row_dispatch/dispatch code stays identical. All117SPIR-V modules match and native checks pass. First definition-order control0e9a compiled identically and is retained without timing. Control is not a product change.

workload.phase_scope: Each phase resets history; decode is not continuation after prefill. One warmup of each phase precedes r1.
workload.context: All measured arms use model logical context262144 with lazy backing and identical token histories. Historical mx is not a measured arm.

limitations: Two calls per workload/arm in forward/reverse order; no statistical certainty from two samples.
All three measured llmx arms use the same Linux container/image and physical MI50 with four CPU threads. Historical mx rates remain separate.
All measured arms share model logical context and token histories. Historical mx used context512 and independent reset decode, so no new matched reference comparison is claimed.
Model loading and warmups lie outside reported rates but inside process activity windows. Unknown activity stays unknown.
Numerical/HF/split/server qualification and unchanged-type controls are separate retained work, not proved by these speed calls.
No reference workload in this12-call repeat. Existing reference preflight only validates unchanged historical source/library/device pins.
This is a compiler/implementation sensitivity control, not a pure layout band; no achieved occupancy or code-only attribution follows from its timing.
Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.
Control source/build/emission proof is pinned by admission_evidence; its exact applicability is stated in control_interpretation, not inferred from changed source.

The first definition-reorder control was ineffective and never timed. The min-spelling control preserves the reachable32/64/128 height mapping but is a compiler perturbation, not necessarily pure layout.
All 12 calls retained. Two samples per arm/workload; r1 SD0 is not repeatability evidence.
Whole-call activity and rusage include loading, warmup and both phases. No phase-specific activity attribution.
Boundary samples can overlap calls. Arm totals are descriptive and cannot be summed into unique observations.
Missing/new/departed process observations remain unknown. GPU ranges have no process attribution.
Original eight-call screen and historical mx rates remain separate; no pooled statistic, cross-round paired ratio, gate waiver or matched-reference parity claim.
